body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'Surfaces 2009') -- <Visual News> QuickStep introduced two new product collections at Surfaces 2009, which is the high-gloss exotics 'Allustra' collection and the 'Sculptiue' collections of softly hand-scraped, rustic decors.

These two new collections provide the consumer extraordinary style at an affordable price. Each of these collections features Quick-Step's patented Uniclic easy-installation locking system and is backed by the brand's limited lifetime warranty.

Allustra is the definition of lustrous elegance, achieved by highlighting exotic wood looks with a smooth, flossy surface. The collection's 6 1/8" wide single-planks feature a fine micro-beveled v-groove on all four sides and are available in six different species looks.

Sculptique collection can be found in the warm look of lightly hand-scraped surfaces that lend a beautifully time-worn appearance. The collection's 6 1/8" wide planks are available in varying species represented in the five decors and feature scalloped edges on all four sides.
